title: Removal of the Nose Wheel Steering Manifold from the Nose Gear Bay

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the nose wheel steering manifold from the nose gear bay, covering both the built-up manifold and the machined block standard, with the depressurisation and accumulator discharge that must precede it.

sections.purpose: This task removes the nose wheel steering manifold from the nose gear bay so that it can be exchanged, converted or bench tested.
sections.job_setup_note: The green hydraulic system must be depressurised and the steering accumulator discharged before any joint is broken. An accumulator that has not been discharged will drive the manifold off its hard points when the last bolt is removed. The nose gear must be down and locked with the ground locks fitted, and the aircraft must not be towed while this task is in progress.
sections.procedure: 1. Put the aircraft on its wheels with the nose gear down and locked. 2. Install the nose gear ground lock and put the warning notice in the flight compartment. WARNING: DO NOT WORK IN THE NOSE GEAR BAY UNTIL THE GROUND LOCK IS INSTALLED AND THE WARNING NOTICE IS IN PLACE. 3. Depressurise the green hydraulic system and confirm zero pressure at the bay gauge. 4. Discharge the steering accumulator through the charging port and confirm zero nitrogen pressure. CAUTION: A CHARGED ACCUMULATOR STORES ENOUGH ENERGY TO MOVE THE MANIFOLD WHEN THE LAST BOLT IS REMOVED. CONFIRM ZERO PRESSURE AT THE GAUGE, NOT AT THE VALVE. 5. Get access through the bay in zones 711 and 714. 6. Label and disconnect the electrical connector at the position sensor FIN 9WS. 7. Disconnect the hydraulic pipes at the manifold and cap every open end immediately. 8. Support the manifold on the cradle. 9. Remove the manifold attachment bolts in the reverse of the torque sequence. 10. Lower the manifold onto the cradle and remove it from the bay. 11. Collect the residual fluid in the drain tray and dispose of it as scheduled waste. 12. Cap the manifold ports and put the manifold in its transport container.
sections.close_out: Leave the pipe ends capped and the bay clear. Fit the blanking plate over the manifold hard points if the aircraft is to be left overnight. Make an entry in the technical log that nose wheel steering is inoperative and that the aircraft must be towed by the towbar only.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Step 4 charging port position differs post MOD-154905.

safety_precautions: Install the nose gear ground lock before you enter the bay.
Confirm zero hydraulic pressure at the bay gauge.
Confirm zero nitrogen pressure before removing the last bolt.
